notes: Input set: image 1 = main-floor plan (3 units, imperial, chains 3 x 18'-0" and 38'-0" + 8'-0" = 46'-0"); image 2 = garage/basement plan of the same set (no chains, scale transferred from sheet 1 unit width); image 3 = as-built front photo; image 4 = colour rendering; image 5 = identical copy of image 4 (SHEET SET RULE: not counted). Indices in references/raw_estimates use these numbers.

Country: United States, high certainty - imperial plan dimensions, US sectional garage doors, vinyl lap siding, architectural asphalt shingles, wood deck stairs. Calc profile US; only [US] + [INVARIANT] used.

Photo assessment (chat run, no triage): photo 3 front, slightly_angled (yaw ~10 deg, camera slightly low), occluded ~25 % (stairs, deck rails cover the garage storey); photo 4 front, slightly_angled rendering (artistic proportions, low reliability), occluded ~20 % (stairs, trees at both ends). No usable side view -> depth_basis oblique_only.
Scope: the whole 3-unit building (triplex of rowhouses) is measured as one building; building_type unknown because the enum describes single units. Each unit is 18'-0" wide; units are identical.

Building: 3 storeys at the front (garage storey at grade with garage + basement behind, main floor on the raised covered porch level, upper floor); main roof hip with ridge parallel to the front; three front cross gables flush with the front wall (one per unit, at the unit's left part); continuous covered porch roof with three porch gables over raised wood decks on posts, one exterior stair per unit descending toward the street.

Consolidation in chat: eave = weighted median 8327 mm (5 estimates, spread 12.5 %), ridge = 10462 mm (5 estimates, 11969 dropped as >10 % outlier, spread 8.7 %), total width photo median 15940 mm vs plan 16459 mm (plan kept).
Wide-angle: in photo 3 the right building corner lies ~11 % from the right frame edge; no compression correction applied.
